body:
Real research into Asterisk's 3 control surfaces. Key finding: AMI's wire format is a direct structural sibling of sip/message.prn's own header-parsing shape. Recommends AMI first over ARI/AGI. Real 4-phase plan. Golden doc PBX-ASTERISK-NORTH. Commit 42c9bd6. Planning only.

⚓ ☃
title: Asterisk bindings research + plan (kanban PBX-002)
